shortDescription: Thailand's monetary policy should remain accommodative to support economic recovery,  the minutes of the central bank's August 26 meeting showed on Wednesday.

children: Thailand's monetary policy should remain accommodative to support economic recovery,  the minutes of the central bank's August 26 meeting showed on Wednesday.

At the meeting, the Bank of Thailand's monetary policy committee unanimously voted to maintain the one-day repurchase rate (THCBIR=ECI) at 1.00% for a third straight time, saying growth was low and uneven.
Last week, BOT Governor Vitai Ratanakorn said monetary policy was fully accommodative and suitable for the economy, which he said was expected to grow 2.3% this year.
The next policy review is on October 28.
